# MOLDIN.india®

> MOLDIN.india® connects good creators with brands across India. We manage multiple curated, quality-vetted creators together and take over full-scale brand collaboration campaigns end to end—from strategy and creator casting to script supervision and multi-creator publishing waves.

## Core Brand Collaboration Pages
- [Home](https://moldin.in/): Overview of managed creator collective, full-campaign execution model, Nonstop Energy (100+ reels posted) and SunoSunao.ai (40+ reels posted) track record, and direct WhatsApp brand collaboration access.
- [For Brands](https://moldin.in/brands.html): End-to-end campaign management structure, category coverage, and instant brand brief intake for marketing teams.
- [Campaigns](https://moldin.in/campaigns.html): Past campaign deliveries (more than 10+ brand campaigns completed till date, including Nonstop Energy 100+ reels and SunoSunao.ai 40+ reels) and execution categories.
- [Blogs & Brand Playbooks](https://moldin.in/blogs.html): In-depth guides for brand founders and marketers on running full-scale multi-creator Instagram Reels campaigns in India.
- [Creators Collective](https://moldin.in/creators.html): Featured talent collective led by Amlendra Kumar (626K followers, AI & Apps) and Sandesh Agrawal (88K followers, Tech & AI) alongside Travel, Fashion, Beauty, Fitness, and Model creators.

## Verified Track Record
- More than 10+ full-scale brand campaigns delivered till date.
- Nonstop Energy campaign: 100+ creators/reels posted end to end.
- SunoSunao.ai campaign: 40+ reels posted across curated creators.
- Managed verticals: Tech & AI, Consumer Apps, Fashion, Beauty, Fitness, Travel, and Modeling.
